item.title: Sanity Launches AI Content Operating System
item.description: Built around three pillars — model your business, automate everything, and power anything — Sanity gives teams the structured foundation, automation layer, and agentic context to run AI in production.

item.title: AI Becomes the Connective Tissue of Marketing Organisations
item.description: AI is moving beyond experimentation to become the connective layer linking data, creativity, media, and measurement. As agentic systems mature, marketing organisations are beginning to orchestrate entire customer journeys through AI-driven collaboration across teams and channels.

item.title: AI Digital Launches AI Labs Incubator & Transformation Consultancy
item.description: The Incubator is the second program under AI Digital Labs, following the AI Creative Studio, which helps agencies bring creative and media concepts to life rapidly with production-quality outputs at scale.

item.title: Clari + Salesloft, 1mind Partner to Advance AI-Driven Revenue Orchestration
item.description: The collaboration integrates Clari + Salesloft's innovative Predictive Revenue System with 1mind's Superhumans — AI digital teammates designed to accelerate pipeline from first touch to close across the customer lifecycle.

item.title: DataDome, Botify Partner to Give Businesses Control Over Agentic Commerce
item.description: This partnership combines Botify's expertise in ensuring agents and bots can fully consume the right optimised content with DataDome's ability to distinguish legitimate agents from malicious bots.

item.title: Forsta Introduces New AI Agents in Research HX
item.description: Forsta’s AI agents embed intelligence directly into the research process, from survey setup and metadata management to verbatim analysis and executive-ready reporting.

item.title: Luma Unveils Luma Agents Powered by Unified Intelligence for Creative Work
item.description: Built on Luma’s new Unified Intelligence architecture, Luma Agents introduce a new category of AI collaborators and are deployed today with global enterprise partners, including Publicis Groupe and Serviceplan Group.

item.title: Zen Media Launches GEO GPT to Measure Brand Visibility in AI Answers
item.description: GEO GPT is available directly inside ChatGPT, allowing organisations to begin their AI visibility diagnostic within the same environment where buyers increasingly conduct research.

item.title: Marquee Awards Celebrate Campaign Performance & the Innovation Behind It
item.description: In a world where creativity dominates the marketing and advertising community, Marquee Awards focus on ideas in action, the strategy that drives business impact through measurable value.

item.title: Women in Leadership Share Their Journey Climbing the Corporate Ladder
item.description: On International Women’s Day, Martechvibe asked women in leadership roles across marketing, finance, and technology about what advice they would give their younger selves starting out their careers, knowing all they know now.
